newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end flat after wide fluctuations.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end flat after wide fluctuations.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended flat on Thursday after wide fluctuations amid foreign investor buying, dealers said.
The Karachi bourse 100-share index ended 0.90 point, or 0.06 percent, lower at 1,602.68, after rising to 1,606.64 and falling to 1,593.15 in early trade. Losers led gainers 196 to 84.

Increased buying of PTCL stocks by some foreign buyers helped the index close flat, dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said. PTCL rose 0.40 rupee to 31.10, HUBCO 0.15 to 38.10 and Shell Pakistan 11 to 241. Pakistan State Oil fell 5.00 to 272 and Philips Electric 10 to 65.
